ApiNamedQuery.body2: SELECT Id, Name, LDGCRM_Email__c, LDGCRM_External_ID__c, LDGCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Team_Name__c, LDGCRM_P3_Team_UUID__c, LGDCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Admin__c, LDGCRM_contact__r.Name, LDGCRM_Application__r.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM LDGCRM_Application_Contact__c WHERE LDGCRM_P3_Team_UUID__c = :teamuuid ORDER BY Name DESC
ApiNamedQuery.description: Login.gov Partnership Portal Integration. Application Contacts for one Partner Portal team. Equality, not LIKE, so it cannot silently drop the 248 rows that have no team.
ApiNamedQuery.masterLabel: Login.gov Application Contacts - By Team UUID

apiNamedQueryParameters.description: The Partner Portal team UUID to match exactly.
